name: Waldstetten (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically yellow and blue, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Waldstetten (a yellow lion on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Waldstetten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Waldstetten arms — yellow lion on blue
